continuation.end: Alden reaches Clytem Zhao’s voicemail, apologizes for his late reply and accepts the funeral invitation if transport is not too much trouble. Decision made, he dresses, takes his pillow and invites Victor to get tuna and meet someone, joking about demons. They have not reached Gorgon yet.
